!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Cells were treated with 100 nM dexamethasone, 10 nM 17-beta-estradiol, or vehicle control (DMSO) for 1 hour prior to trypsinization.
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: Ishikawa cells were grown in phenol red-free RPMI-1640 media supplemented with 10% charcoal/dextran treated fetal bovine serum and 50 units/mL penicillin and 50 µg/mL streptomycin for at least 4 days before lysis.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were lysed with RLT (Qiagen) plus 1% BME and total RNA was extracted from the lysis using Zymo's Quick RNA miniprep kit.

Differential expression was determined using DESeq2 V 1.14.1
